confidence_notes: I ran three web searches: one for the RBA rate and two for Jaipur food and drink prices. The price results were crowdsourced cost-of-living aggregators from mixed years, plus a few undated or venue-specific listings, so they disagree with each other. Restaurant meal and coffee anchors rest on those aggregators (inexpensive meal about ₹300, cappuccino about ₹50-200, mid-range dinner for two about ₹850-1,000 in the sources, adjusted upward for a three-course meal at a tourist-oriented mid-range place). Beer is based on restaurant or pub prices of roughly ₹250-400, with the source listings ranging from about ₹160 for a draught pint to ₹400 for a bottle. Cocktail and wine rest on one thin Expatistan figure (about ₹717 per cocktail, 8 data points, 2023) and an older undated Lonely Planet venue listing (wine from ₹600, cocktails from ₹650). I weighted them toward typical tourist-bar prices, so these two are less certain. I assumed about ₹88-90 per USD for converting rupee prices. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge of Jaipur's tourist market; I did not search for or inspect any accommodation prices or listings.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Jaipur-specific aggregated price indexes. Accommodation is comparable to other Rajasthan heritage-tourism cities such as Udaipur and Jodhpur, and to Delhi at a slightly lower level.
